adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent`, `selectedCalendar` is now computed as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. If `externalCalendarId` is falsy (undefined/null/""), the `.find(...)` compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (falsy), which will typically yield no match and thus `selectedCalendar` becomes `undefined` even when `event.destinationCalendar` contains calendars. Unlike `createEvent`, there is no `|| "primary"` fallback shown for update, so this can cause updates to call the Google API with an undefined `calendarId` and fail.
